clarifications.question: npm run check is a plain && chain in package.json; how can it skip layers?
clarifications.answer: check becomes a runner mode (node scripts/framework-check.mjs check) and the chain moves unchanged to a new check-full script (npm and make). The runner classifies the change, then runs npm run check-full, or npm run lint and a SKIP line for every other step of check-full. Makefile check delegates to the runner too; make check-full keeps the old prerequisite chain.

clarifications.question: Which consumers of the check chain must follow it to check-full?
clarifications.answer: confirmationLayerCommand (new features' Layer 3, feat-038) reads check-full when it exists; harness-upgrade's check-arch-in-chain hint reads check-full when check is the runner; the adoption matrix's normalizeFixtureScripts writes both. verify-feature runs its layers with HARNESS_CHECK_FULL=1, so a Layer 3 of npm run check stays full.

clarifications.question: What is the change set, and what if it is empty?
clarifications.answer: Files changed between the merge-base with the default branch (same base resolution as evidence-check, without failing) and HEAD, plus uncommitted and untracked files, relative to the current directory. An empty set (for example a clean default branch) or no resolvable base runs every layer.

clarifications.question: Which files are documentation?
clarifications.answer: A file under docs/ (any type, so docs/demo assets count), or a .md file anywhere except under skills/ and templates/. AGENTS.md, DECISIONS.md, README.md and progress notes are documentation; lint already validates the README, must-rules, command surfaces and progress log. SKILL.md files and templates are shipped to adopters and run every layer.

clarifications.question: How do CI and --full interact?
clarifications.answer: npm run check -- --full, make check FULL=1, or HARNESS_CHECK_FULL=1 run every layer. Both CI workflows run npm run check -- --full on every event (and make check FULL=1 for the Makefile surface), so CI never scopes.

clarifications.question: What does a scoped run report?
clarifications.answer: Before the first layer: the scope (docs-only, with the file count, or full with the reason). After lint: one [SKIP] line per skipped check-full step with the reason docs-only change, and a closing line saying those layers were not verified. A check-full that is not a plain && chain of npm run steps, or has no npm run lint step, always runs in full.
